CASE-5012.title: Workload Identity Federation failing for cross-org GKE
CASE-5012.description: Customer's GKE workloads in project A can no longer impersonate a service account in project B after a WIF pool change. OIDC token exchange returns PERMISSION_DENIED. Needs trace of the attribute mapping, pool/provider config, and the SA IAM bindings across both orgs.

CASE-5019.title: Custom VPC peering + Cloud NAT asymmetric routing drops
CASE-5019.description: Intermittent packet loss between a peered VPC and an on-prem range. Suspected asymmetric routing through Cloud NAT after a custom route change. Requires reading effective routes, NAT logs, and firewall rules and reasoning about the path.

CASE-5023.title: Cloud SQL read replica lag spikes under batch load
